name: Osmakasaurus
sum: An iguanodontian from the Early Cretaceous Lakota Formation of South Dakota, named in 2011 for material once called Camptosaurus depressus.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: USNM 4753, found by Nelson Horatio Darton in 1896 in the Lakota Formation.
material: The holotype only in the sources consulted.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: McDonald 2011
